fact: Micron does not expect memory-chip tightness to ease until 2028
why: Micron's own timing is new, but judge already has NVIDIA's CFO expecting the supply bottleneck through fiscal 2028 and Micron's shortage; it confirms and leaves rung 5 where it is.

fact: Nvidia projects GPU short supply to continue; forecasts 70% revenue growth next year
why: Repeat of the supply-constrained 70% guide (e106) and continuing bottleneck (e236). Tight supply with strong growth keeps commitments high, supporting rung 5; nothing new for the judge.

fact: Huang said Nvidia would double the number of chips it sells in 2027
why: Judge has 70% revenue growth and a conditional 'could double', not this unit forecast. Twice the chips needs far more secured supply, so falling below $200bn is less likely.
